In recognition of Compliance with the established Standards 
for Accreditation, the Council on Academic Accreditation in 
Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology hereby accredits 
the entry-level graduate program in Speech-Language 
Pathology at University of Wisconsin Stevens Point

Successfully completed the accredited program 
from June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027.

This certificate confirms completion of a professionally 
accredited program in communication sciences and disorders.
